attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 5 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man: the one who gave himself to the service of the confessors in prison, offered himself to the judge, was tortured and beheaded. saint.gr adds that his body was then thrown into the sea, which the folder did not hold. It gives no year and no persecutor, so the folder's dateless state stands. No hymn is printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
